summary: Signed scalar assignment promoted negative isize operands through UsizePromotion (u32/u64), turning them into large positive values and producing incorrect arithmetic. The fix uses IsizePromotion (i32/i64), preserving the sign. The implementation reversal is exact and unique, but no detecting upstream test was found at this revision: the fix adds no tests, bigint_scalar tests exercise non-assignment operators, bigint assignment tests use BigInt operands, and CI tests do not exercise negative isize assignment. Planning is blocked by the missing detecting test; no tests were run.
